en: The postcard shows a bustling market square with numerous stalls and many people. There is a prominent baroque-style building with a clock tower, a large Gothic church, and a statue of a rider on horseback on a pedestal. The architecture and the animated market scene suggest a European city. The words 'Weissenfels.' and 'Markt.' are printed on the card, indicating the location is the marketplace of Weißenfels.
